correctness.rationale: For a subset of the defined 20-vertex GP(10,3), components of size at most two are equivalent to induced degree at most one. An independent run generated the faces recursively and cross-checked all 2^20 masks, obtaining 62,049 faces including the empty face and the stated facet and dimension counts. On the nonempty faces the greedy vertex matching leaves the advertised (1,3,44) cells in dimensions (0,6,7) after 31,000 pairings. A complete topological order checks all 400,760 directed incidences, sufficient for Forman's theorem. The independent integral calculation matches the signed three-column witness for masks 0x18e94, 0x55292 and 0x61664 in the claimed 6-cell basis. In the Morse projection a matched upper generator dies and the matched lower face is solved out using the ±1 incidence in its partner's boundary; subsequent lower-face terms occur farther along directed paths, so the recursion terminates. The determinant −1 makes the differential onto over Z, with kernel free of rank 41. The resulting CW model is 5-connected from its cell dimensions; Hurewicz with H₆=0 then makes it 6-connected. Hurewicz representatives for a basis of H₇ give a map from the wedge of 41 seven-spheres that is an integral homology equivalence between simply connected CW complexes and hence a homotopy equivalence. The finite computational certificate supports that nonequivariant conclusion; it is not formal or equivariant verification. The frozen script was not executed.
